Distribution brand checklist

Use this checklist whenever Offing is added to or updated on a public surface. The approved source of truth is the brand guide; do not redesign the identity for an individual channel.

Universal checks

  • Use Offing as the display name and offing only where a package or machine identifier is required.
  • Use the tagline exactly as Know what breaks next.
  • Use the descriptor exactly as Local-first deprecation intelligence for software repositories. when category clarity is required.
  • Use Evidence-backed migration context for humans and coding agents. only as the approved supporting message.
  • Select an approved dark, light, or monochrome asset; never redraw the mark.
  • Preserve clear space, minimum size, and accessible color pairs.
  • Keep official brand content in English and omit personal attribution.
  • Link to the official repository, documentation, and package.
  • Confirm the surface does not imply hosted analysis, automatic code changes, complete ecosystem coverage, or guaranteed migration safety.
  • Re-check the platform's current image and metadata specifications before upload.

Repository and GitHub

  • README uses the adaptive dark/light banner and approved descriptor.
  • Repository description uses the approved descriptor.
  • Homepage points to the public Offing documentation.
  • Repository topics describe the product rather than inventing brand variants.
  • Upload brand/exports/social-preview-dark.png as the repository social preview and inspect a shared link on both light and dark clients.
  • Issue templates use Offing and evidence-backed language consistently.

Documentation

  • Site title and description match approved naming.
  • Header uses the adaptive Version Notches mark.
  • Home page uses the approved tagline, descriptor, and supporting language.
  • Light and dark palettes use approved accessible pairs.
  • Brand guidance and asset terms are discoverable from public documentation.
  • The site remains static, dependency-light, and free of decorative raster downloads on documentation pages.

npm

  • Package ID remains offing.
  • Description matches the approved product descriptor.
  • Homepage, repository, bugs, license, and relevant discovery keywords exist.
  • Reconfirm packed contents and rendered npm README before each publish.

GitHub Action and Marketplace

  • Action name contains Offing and identifies lifecycle intelligence.
  • Action description is local-first, evidence-backed, and function-specific.
  • Marketplace icon/color use the closest supported neutral treatment.
  • Marketplace logo and feature-card sources exist in brand/.
  • Preview marketplace metadata and images before creating or updating a listing.

Agent Skill and future plugins

  • Agent Skill metadata names Offing and preserves trigger clarity.
  • Skill content states the local execution and evidence boundaries.
  • Reuse the approved name, descriptor, mark, and asset terms in every future plugin manifest and directory listing.
  • Run host-specific discovery and context-cost evaluations before submission.

Listing versions (reviewed 2026-10-29 against release 0.7.1)

Record the version each public Skill or plugin surface shows after a release. The current npm package, Action tag, and generated plugin pins are 0.7.1.

  • skills.sh lists velella-sh/offing@offing. The page has no package version field; install resolves from the repository Skill on main, which matches the Skill shipped in 0.7.1.
  • Claude repository marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/claude/) publishes plugin version 0.7.1 and pins @velella/offing@0.1.0.
  • Codex repository marketplace (plugins/codex/) publishes plugin version 0.7.1 and pins @velella/offing@0.1.0. OpenAI's public plugin directory still has no Offing entry (submission tracked separately).

Releases

  • Use the approved banner or social-preview template for launch posts.
  • Keep release notes factual; lead with lifecycle coverage and evidence.
  • Confirm changelog, package metadata, Action metadata, and documentation agree.
  • Verify every referenced asset exists in the tagged commit.
  • Check all external links and render the README and documentation in light and dark modes.

Asset audit

The canonical editable assets live in brand/assets/ and brand/templates/. Canonical raster exports live in brand/exports/. The documentation copy at docs/assets/brand/offing-mark-adaptive.svg is the only intentional duplicate; it exists because the GitHub Pages source is scoped to docs/. No legacy logo or pre-brand social asset remains in the repository.
